title: DevExp huddle: SDK examples & quickstart priorities
summary: Weekly huddle notes focusing on which SDK examples and quickstarts to prioritize for the next two sprints. Triage of flaky sample CI, schedule for quickstart mini-guides, and owners for customer onboarding deliverables.
body:
Meeting: DevExp huddle — SDK examples & quickstart priorities
Date: 2026-06-17 10:30-11:00 PT (30m)
Location: #devexp huddle / Zoom
Attendees: Maya Patel (owner), Rafael Gomez, Priya Nair, Liam O'Connor, Zoe Chang, Harper Lee

Agenda:
- Quick review of current sample backlog and customer onboarding needs
- Decide top 3 quickstarts to finish (Python, Node, and a mini serverless example)
- Triage flaky sample CI and PR blocking release
- Assign owners and due dates for docs + examples for customer X trial (start 2026-07-01)

Notes / updates:
1) Backlog snapshot (Rafael)
- Current sample/quickstart backlog: ~18 items. High-impact candidates: "chatbot-function-calls", "embeddings-search-demo", "streaming-realtime-chat", "serverless-lambda-quickstart".
- Usage telemetry: Python quickstart page views >> Node by 3x; customers still reference the old captureboard example (we should deprecate and replace).

2) SDK release & blocking PRs (Liam)
- Targeting SDK v0.8.2 release end of sprint (2026-06-30).
- Blocking: GH PR #342 is failing flaky CI on macOS runners (intermittent auth token tear-down). PR link: https://github.com/redwood-inference/sdk/pull/342
- Temporary mitigation: cut a release candidate excluding the flaky integration test if PR not fixed by 2026-06-22.

3) Quickstart prioritization (Priya + Zoe) — decision summary
- Top priority quickstarts to ship before 2026-07-01:
  a) python/quickstart-min: minimal end-to-end text generation (50% completion) — owner: Priya — due 2026-06-24
  b) node/quickstart-streaming: demonstrate streaming responses with function calling stub (30% completion) — owner: Zoe — due 2026-06-28
  c) serverless/lambda-embedding-cache: tiny serverless example showing embeddings + local prefix cache pattern (not full infra) — owner: Rafael — due 2026-06-30
- Rationale: these three cover the majority of new user intents (generate, stream/call functions, embeddings) and align with the customer X onboarding checklist.

4) Mini-guides (Harper)
- Create 1-page "minidocs" to sit above each quickstart: "What this quickstart shows", "Expected cost profile", "Troubleshooting common errors", "Test checklist for CI".
- Template ready by 2026-06-20. Harper to draft template and circulate.

5) CI flaky test triage (Liam + Maya)
- Repro steps captured in the PR comment thread; likely race in token refresh when running integration tests concurrently.
- Action: add gating step to run macOS integration tests sequentially for PRs touching auth or examples. Liam to add gating change (CI config) by 2026-06-19. If gating doesn't stabilize within 48h, revert the failing test to unit-only and move integration coverage to nightly matrix.

6) Customer X onboarding deliverables (Maya)
- Customer X trial starts 2026-07-01. They require: python quickstart, node streaming sample, and a short "Deploy to VPC" checklist (private-deployments cross-team help).
- Need private-deployments SME to review the VPC checklist by 2026-06-25. Action: Maya to @-DM on Slack to Priya from private-deployments.

7) Docs review flow and PR SLA (Priya)
- Agreed: docs PRs for quickstarts get 48h review SLA from at least one tech writer + one engineer. If not reviewed in SLA, ping rotation owner.
- Add label devexp/docs-quickstart to repo to identify urgent quickstart PRs. Zoe to add label and update contributing.md by 2026-06-18.

Open questions / risks:
- Risk: if GH PR #342 remains blocked, release cadence delayed affecting customer X ramp. Mitigation: RC without the test, but that leaves less integration coverage.
- Risk: private-deployments SME bandwidth (may push VPC checklist review past 2026-06-25). Have backup: engage Solutions Engineering (Rafael) for an initial pass.
- Question: should we keep the old captureboard example live? Consensus: deprecate and replace with a leaner, easier-to-run sample. Rafael to prepare deprecation note by 2026-06-21.

Decisions made:
- Prioritize python-min, node-streaming, serverless-embedding quickstarts for 2026-06-30 milestone.
- Implement CI gating change for macOS integration tests (Liam) and fallback to nightly matrix if unstable.
- Adopt 48h docs PR SLA for quickstarts; add repo label devexp/docs-quickstart.

Action items (owner — due):
- Priya: finish python/quickstart-min content + test checklist — 2026-06-24
- Zoe: implement streaming example + sample function-calls stub (PR to sdk-examples) — 2026-06-28
- Rafael: serverless embedding quickstart + deprecation note for captureboard — 2026-06-30 (deprecate note by 2026-06-21)
- Harper: draft minidocs template and example for python quickstart — 2026-06-20
- Liam: adjust CI gating for macOS integration tests and triage PR #342 flakiness — 2026-06-19
- Maya: coordinate private-deployments review and ping Solutions Eng if needed — 2026-06-18
- Zoe: add repo label devexp/docs-quickstart and update contributing.md — 2026-06-18

Quick links mentioned:
- PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/sdk/pull/342
- Confluence: https://confluence.redwood.ai/display/DEV/SDK+Docs+Backlog
- Linear/Jira: DEVEXP-128 (sample backlog), JIRA-DOCS-45 (customer X docs request)

Notes to self / rough followups:
- Consider a small "quickstart smoke" GitHub Actions job (under 5m run) that validates each quickstart at PR time — discussion next week.
- Evaluate embedding sample for cost estimates to include in minidoc (Harper + Rafael).
- Might need marketing review for public-facing quickstarts; add marketing review step for any quickstart marked "public".

Next meeting: short sync Tue 2026-06-23 09:00 PT (15m) to confirm PR progress and CI status.

End of notes.

Draft history: created 2026-06-17 by Maya Patel; shared to devexp channel and PR threads.
